thesis: The episode explores the evolution of the cryptocurrency market, highlighting its fragmentation across exchange rules, regulatory regimes, and order book models as both risk and opportunity. It explains why traditional high-frequency funds have not dominated the space and discusses the specific advantages of market-neutral strategies that emerged in crypto by summer 2018.
